Title: Shelf-share check
Description: Count facings vs. competitors on the main shelf.

Title: Planogram compliance
Description: Confirm products are placed per the current planogram.

Title: Expiry & freshness audit
Description: Check date codes and remove near-expiry stock.

Title: Price-tag verification
Description: Verify shelf prices match the recommended price list.

Title: Cooler hygiene
Description: Inspect branded cooler cleanliness and temperature.

Title: Promo material placement
Description: Install or refresh point-of-sale promo material.

Title: Out-of-stock capture
Description: Record SKUs that are out of stock and raise an order.

Title: Owner feedback
Description: Log retailer feedback and competitor activity.
